summary: KT Corp filed a Form 6-K announcing a board resolution to set a record date of July 29, 2026, for its quarterly cash dividend. The dividend follows Article 49-2 of the company's articles of incorporation, and the shareholders' register will not be closed. This is a routine dividend record date announcement, not a special situation. No transaction, price, premium, or advisor is involved. The filing is a standard periodic report on dividend mechanics, with no restructuring, acquisition, or other special event.
